cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

mechanism: A treats its former meal-review pupil dangerous birthday-cake question as premature and keeps completing earlier lunch questions with sincere detail.
confusable: Not generic silence or distraction: A returns to an identified earlier question and gives its actual answer each time.
comparison: Responsibility for a crash versus eating another person cake.
seedUse: D230 lunch good/soup/cake/who/forget lunch/where ate; S05 food description teaching.
